ev.q: The explanation is neat, but there is little documentary evidence to support it

1.why: B段：防员工偷钱的起源说法很流行，但缺乏证据。iii A doubtful account of how it began ↔ Even the origins … are uncertain … little documentary evidence to support it。i 是陷阱：防止员工偷钱只是那个说法的内容，而作者对这个说法持怀疑态度，它不是整段主旨。

ev.q: they pay most attention to the first digit

2.why: C段讲左位数效应。ix The importance of the first figure ↔ pay most attention to the first digit … left-digit effect。

ev.q: Evidence from real markets supports the idea that such small differences can matter.

3.why: D段用邮购目录实验和二手车市场的真实数据作证据。ii What actual purchases reveal ↔ Evidence from real markets。

ev.q: Price endings may also send messages about the product itself.

4.why: E段首句即主旨：价格尾数传达关于产品的信息（便宜、奢侈、用途）。viii The meaning a price can carry ↔ send messages about the product itself。iv 是细节陷阱：段中只说奢侈品用整数价格，没解释奢侈品为什么贵。

ev.q: The effect is not equally strong everywhere.

5.why: F段：在某些国家、品类、关注价格的顾客中，以及网购时效果变弱。v Conditions that reduce the influence of endings ↔ weak or absent … smaller among shoppers … much less influenced。x 是细节陷阱：网购只是其中一种情况。

ev.q: the episode shows something more modest

6.why: G段：J.C. Penney 取消尾数定价失败，作者认为真正的教训是顾客已经习惯找“便宜”。xi A failed experiment and its real lesson ↔ Sales fell sharply … reversed … the episode shows something more modest。vii 与原文相反：改变是失败的。

ev.q: there is little documentary evidence to support it

7.why: B段。Historians agree ↔ 作者说这个说法 neat, but there is little documentary evidence，与“已被证实”相矛盾，所以是 NO。

ev.q: Remarkably, the version priced at $39 sold more than the version priced at $34

8.why: D段。unexpected ↔ Remarkably … even though it was more expensive。作者用 Remarkably 表达了意外。

ev.q: Some studies have found it to be weak or absent in particular countries and product categories

9.why: 文中提到 €（欧元）价格，也说效果在某些国家较弱，但没有比较欧洲和美国哪里更常用尾数9的价格。看到 particular countries 就推断出 YES 或 NO 都是过度推断。

ev.q: It is tempting to conclude that prices ending in 9 have an almost magical power over shoppers, but the episode shows something more modest

10.why: G段。shoppers are almost powerless against charm pricing ↔ an almost magical power over shoppers。作者说人们容易这样下结论，紧接着用 but … something more modest 否定了它，所以是 NO，不是 YES。

ev.q: they tend to suggest that something is a bargain

11.why: E段。make an item appear ↔ tend to suggest that something is；good value ↔ a bargain。G overpriced 意思相反。

ev.q: sellers of luxury goods usually avoid them and prefer round numbers such as $200

12.why: E段。companies selling luxury products ↔ sellers of luxury goods；whole figures ↔ round numbers。B luxurious 修饰产品，不能修饰 figures；D precise 与 round 意思相反。

ev.q: prices ending in 9 worked better for purchases made for practical reasons, such as cleaning products

13.why: E段末句。more effective for ↔ worked better for；functional purchases ↔ purchases made for practical reasons。E emotional 对应的是 buying something for pleasure，那是整数价格更受欢迎的情况。
